lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Burkina Faso. The dataset contains approximately 942.7 thousand mapped buildings with metadata on data currency (average 4 years old, 2% updated in last 6 months) and AI-based coverage estimates (approximately 12% of total buildings). Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage).
